text:
Olivia Park: Kicking off a short sync — want a compact solution brief + gated one-pager for the next enterprise push. Goal: make it easy for AEs to send to security/compliance teams. Key pillars: SLA language, data residency options, quick benchmark takeaway, and a one-click request-demo CTA.
Diego Mendez: Agreed. Can we also include a tiny "what to expect after you request a demo" flow so buyers know timelines? That drops friction.
Hannah Schwartz: I'll draft the brief. Tone: factual, not salesy. Two versions: a printable PDF for AEs and a condensed HTML for gated landing. Also want a 2-sentence social lead and a short benchmark highlight for the hero banner.
Olivia Park: For the benchmark highlight, avoid hard commitments — prefer comparative phrasing. Something like: "Dedicated deployments deliver predictable P95 latency; Private deployments yield lowest unit cost when amortized." Diego, can engineering give a single-row benchmark we can show as a chart?
Diego Mendez: Yes. Quick stat we can share: typical P95 token latency ranges (hosted ~100-180ms, dedicated ~50-90ms, private 80-160ms) and unit-cost band (hosted: baseline, dedicated: ~45% lower at scale, private: lowest when fully amortized). I'll produce a small CSV and a PNG chart.
Hannah Schwartz: Great. For the landing form fields I'm proposing: 
```
- email
- full_name
- company
- title
- company_size
- region
- deployment_interest (hosted/dedicated/private)
- compliance_needs (checkboxes)
- expected_traffic
- accept_contact (checkbox)
```
Olivia Park: Add a hidden field "asset_name=enterprise_deploy_brief_2026" and a UTM tag capture. Also we need HubSpot routing rules: if deployment_interest==private or compliance_needs includes FedRAMP/HIPAA -> assign to Enterprise AE + SE; company_size > 1000 -> AE + Solutions Eng; otherwise -> SDR nurture. Can someone paste a pseudo-workflow snippet?
Diego Mendez: Pseudo-workflow: 
```
if form.deployment_interest == "private" or form.compliance_needs contains "FedRAMP" or form.company_size > 1000:
  assign -> "Enterprise-AE"
  notify -> "Solutions-Eng"
else if form.company_size >= 100 and form.deployment_interest == "dedicated":
  assign -> "Mid-Market-AE"
else:
  assign -> "SDR-Nurture"
end
```
Hannah Schwartz: For the brief copy: 1) TL;DR bullets (3), 2) comparison callouts (privacy, SLA, cost), 3) buyer personas + migration playbook (3-step: eval -> pilot -> migrate), 4) methodology appendix with eval snippet and link to CSV.
Olivia Park: Include a short paragraph under "Methodology": "Benchmarks run with a chat-like sequence distribution (50-250 tokens), averaging X tokens per request; cost figures are amortized and illustrative; consult your Solutions Engineer for exact procurement/instance sizing." Diego please fill X with the real avg token count.
Diego Mendez: Avg token per request for our test set = 140. I'll update the copy and upload artifacts to /marketing-assets/enterprise/ by EOD.
Hannah Schwartz: Timeline proposal: copy draft by Tue 15:00, design layout Wed 12:00, gated page + form live Thu 09:00, social teasers scheduled Thu 16:00. Any blockers?
Olivia Park: Add a small sample headline for social: "How enterprise teams cut inference unit cost — tradeoffs and deployment paths". Keep it A/B testable.
MarketingScheduler: Draft assets scheduled for review at 2790018000. Social promos queued for 2790021600 (promo) and 2790025200 (reminder).
QA-Bot: Quick checklist: verify SFDC field mapping, ensure hidden_field present, confirm that form respects privacy checkbox.
Diego Mendez: I'll run the privacy mapping test once the form is up.
Hannah Schwartz: Action items: Diego -> CSV + chart + avg token (due today 18:00). Olivia -> landing copy + demo flow paragraph (due Tue 15:00). Hannah -> one-pager draft + social blurbs (due Tue 15:00).
Olivia Park: Thanks all 680. Let's keep language honest about tradeoffs so AE conversations are efficient. We'll reconvene after the first draft review.
